svg.title: Compiling bytecode with CPython and Serc
svg.desc: Median wall time across ten runs on a 32-vCPU host, with 16 CPython workers and 32 Serc workers. All panels share a scale from zero to one second. Airflow: CPython 324 ms, Serc 79 ms (4.1× faster). Django: CPython 358 ms, Serc 94 ms (3.8× faster). NumPy: CPython 432 ms, Serc 131 ms (3.3× faster). Transformers: CPython 832 ms, Serc 288 ms (2.9× faster).
